mapper.sql: (SELECT count(*) FROM memberships m WHERE m.community_id = c.id)

FROM ( SELECT c.id, c.name, c.description, c.created_at, AS member_count, AS score FROM communities c WHERE c.archived_at IS NULL ) s
WHERE s.score > 0
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.name, c.description, AS member_count, c.created_at FROM communities c JOIN memberships me ON me.community_id = c.id WHERE me.user_id = #{userId} AND me.role = 'member' AND c.archived_at IS NULL ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.id DESC
SELECT count(*) FROM memberships WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND role IN ('owner', 'staff')

SELECT c.id, c.name, AS member_count, c.archived_at, me.role AS my_role, (SELECT count(*) FROM join_requests r WHERE r.community_id = c.id AND r.status = 'pending') AS pending_join_request_count FROM communities c JOIN memberships me ON me.community_id = c.id WHERE me.user_id = #{userId} AND me.role IN ('owner', 'staff') ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.sql: SELECT c.id, c.name, c.description, c.owner_id, u.nickname AS owner_nickname, AS member_count, c.archived_at, c.created_at FROM communities c JOIN users u ON u.id = c.owner_id WHERE c.id = #{id}
mapper.select: INSERT INTO communities (name, description, owner_id) VALUES (#{name}, #{description}, #{ownerId}) RETURNING id
mapper.update: UPDATE communities SET name = #{name}, description = #{description} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE communities SET archived_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND archived_at IS NULL
UPDATE communities SET archived_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id}
